verses.text: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
lines: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

verses.text: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
lines: Come before his presence with singing.

verses.text: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
lines: Know that Yahweh, he is God.
It is he who has made us, and we are his.
We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

verses.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
lines: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
and into his courts with praise.
Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

verses.text: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
